sql:
SELECT
    p.ProductKey,
    p.ProductName,
    round(100.0 * sum(s.NetSales - s.TotalCost) / nullIf(sum(s.NetSales), 0), 2) AS ProfitMarginPercentage
FROM
(
    SELECT
        ProductKey,
        (SalesAmount - ReturnAmount - DiscountAmount) AS NetSales,
        TotalCost
    FROM retail.FactSales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        ProductKey,
        (SalesAmount - ReturnAmount - DiscountAmount) AS NetSales,
        TotalCost
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
) AS s
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
    ON p.ProductKey = s.ProductKey
GROUP BY
    p.ProductKey,
    p.ProductName
HAVING sum(s.NetSales) > 0
ORDER BY ProfitMarginPercentage DESC
LIMIT 10
